name: cung-dang-ra-truong
description: Tôi Đi Đâu Đó — Luyện thi TOEIC & VSTEP Mobile App

scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','icon-192.png','icon-512.png','icon-totoro-192.png','icon-totoro-512.png','icon-totoro-maskable-512.png','favicon.ico','app.ico'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); if(fs.existsSync('js')) fs.cpSync('js', 'www/js', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('data/ocr_lang')) { fs.mkdirSync('www/data/ocr_lang', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('data/ocr_lang', 'www/data/ocr_lang', {recursive:true}); } console.log('Assets copied to www!');"
scripts.sync: npm run copy-assets && npx cap sync
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
